mapper.select: SELECT credential.account_id, secret.secret_key_id, secret.secret_ciphertext, credential.last_accepted_step, credential.version FROM auth_totp_credential credential INNER JOIN auth_totp_secret secret ON secret.credential_id = credential.id WHERE credential.account_id = #{accountId} AND credential.status = 'ACTIVE' AND credential.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: WITH credential AS ( INSERT INTO auth_totp_credential (account_id, last_accepted_step) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{lastAcceptedStep}) ON CONFLICT (account_id) WHERE deleted = 0 DO NOTHING RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO auth_totp_secret (credential_id, secret_key_id, secret_ciphertext) SELECT id, #{secretKeyId}, #{secretCiphertext} FROM credential
mapper.update: WITH credential AS ( UPDATE auth_totp_credential SET last_accepted_step = #{lastAcceptedStep}, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0 RETURNING id ) UPDATE auth_totp_secret SET secret_key_id = #{secretKeyId}, secret_ciphertext = #{secretCiphertext} WHERE credential_id IN (SELECT id FROM credential)
mapper.delete: WITH credential AS ( UPDATE auth_totp_credential SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{expectedVersion} RETURNING id ) DELETE FROM auth_totp_secret WHERE credential_id IN (SELECT id FROM credential)
